'''Doxeti''' was an independent [[City-state/Legends|city-state]] on the continent [[Doxet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. Although the residents of the [[City/Legends|city]] and the outlying settlements ruled themselves, they deferred to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alarik X]] of the [[kingdom of Devit]] on matteres of planetary importance.
